lines.text: The bullet ant has the most painful sting on Earth.
Scientists rate it a perfect four on the pain scale.
The moment it stings you, its venom hijacks your nervous system.
It fires every pain nerve in your body simultaneously.
The burning is so intense your muscles start convulsing.
Your heart rate spikes, and you lose control of your limb.
The pain lasts for twenty-four straight hours.
An Amazonian tribe makes boys wear gloves full of bullet ants as an initiation.
Twenty times before you become a man.
